summary: Frontend-only validation completed for ManuCreator at https://slider-usability.preview.emergentagent.com across desktop and mobile (390x844, 375x667, 320x568), including layout visibility, curve slider behavior, object actions, layers, motifs/templates/image upload, persistence, preview/export, and modal flows.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile drag/swipe, slider does not reliably reach exact boundary values -180/+180 and stops around -178/+178 unless adjusted with +/- buttons.

action_items: Adjust mobile slider track/thumb interaction so full drag range can hit exact -180 and +180 values.
Re-run mobile touch regression for 390x844 / 375x667 / 320x568 after slider edge fix.
critical_code_review_comments: No API/backend dependency in tested flows; behavior is localStorage-driven as expected.
Core editing visibility logic matches requirement: nav/footer hidden during editing and restored after Fertig.
Main missed usability edge is slider boundary precision on touch drag at mobile widths.
seed_data_creation: No seeded data created. LocalStorage key manucreator-design-v1 was cleared during tests for isolation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated desktop and mobile layout constraints, modal flows, localStorage persistence, undo/redo grouping for continuous slider drag, object actions (edit/font/duplicate/lock-unlock/delete-undo), layers actions via action-arrange/nav-layers, motifs/templates/image upload, and preview download flow. One reproducible gap remains: mobile drag/swipe does not hit exact ±180 without +/- nudges.
rca of the issue: Repro: open Wölbung panel on mobile viewport (390x844), drag curve slider thumb to extreme left/right. Observed value settles near -178/+178. Using curve-increase/decrease reaches ±180 immediately, indicating value clamps are correct but drag endpoint mapping under thumb/track geometry does not cover full numeric domain. Mitigation: adjust Radix slider value mapping/hit area or track padding so pointer extremes map to exact min/max.
